steps.observation: You have 10 seconds. What are three strategies for reducing carbon emissions in cities?

steps.action:
1. Expand and electrify public and active transport  
   • Invest in rapid transit (buses, trams, subways) and protected bike lanes  
   • Transition municipal and ride-share fleets to electric vehicles  

2. Improve building energy efficiency  
   • Retrofit insulation, windows, and HVAC systems in existing buildings  
   • Enforce green-building standards (LED lighting, smart controls) for new construction  

3. Ramp up local low-carbon energy  
   • Deploy rooftop and community solar, small-scale wind, and district heating/cooling  
   • Implement smart grids and energy storage to balance renewables
